response.sql:
WITH name_totals AS (
  SELECT races.name,
         SUM(CAST(results.points AS REAL)) AS total_points,
         AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps
  FROM results
  JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  GROUP BY races.name
),
kept AS (
  SELECT name, total_points, average_laps
  FROM name_totals
  WHERE total_points > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM name_totals)
)
SELECT SUM(total_points) AS sum_total_points,
       AVG(average_laps) AS average_laps,
       AVG(total_points - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM name_totals)) AS average_excess_points
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: Missing points and laps are ignored by the aggregate functions; race-name groups with no nonmissing laps do not contribute to the average laps.
